name: restaurant-location-production-readiness
title: Harden restaurant current-location capture for production
description: Persist browser geolocation into restaurant latitude/longitude, validate the coordinate pair at frontend and backend boundaries, and cover the flow with focused tests.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The UI now writes browser GPS values to lat/lng without overwriting line1, validates the optional coordinate pair, and exposes production-safe loading/error states. The resolver rejects partial, non-finite, and out-of-range coordinates before persistence. Focused frontend tests (7/7) and resolver tests (16/16) pass. CI changed-test selection now compares against the current remote base merge-base instead of a potentially stale pull-request base SHA. Physical HTTPS phone GPS accuracy and permission behavior remain manual validation.
